snippet.title: DVOR — Official Trailer | Out September 1
snippet.description:
Dvor is a falling-block game where every piece is a slab of Soviet concrete, and every season changes how the world feels around you.
The board is a construction site. Lock a piece and it becomes part of a living facade: a window, a balcony, a concrete panel. Floor by floor, a Panelka rises from the well.

Play through Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter. Survive long enough and the atmosphere turns to Gold.

Daily Challenge: the same pieces, worldwide, one attempt a day.
Out 1 September 2026 on Steam and itch.io. Windows and Mac.
